eventTips.create: Event triggered when the object is initialized
eventTips.hittrigger: Event triggered when the actor is hit by a trigger
eventTips.hitactor: Event triggered when colliding with the target actor
eventTips.collision: Event triggered when the actor collides with another actor
eventTips.destroy: Event triggered before the object is destroyed
eventTips.playerenter: Event triggered when the player actor enters the area
eventTips.playerleave: Event triggered when the player actor leaves the area
eventTips.actorenter: Event triggered when any actor enters the area
eventTips.actorleave: Event triggered when any actor leaves the area
eventTips.skillcast: Event triggered by the 'Cast Skill' command
eventTips.skilladd: Event triggered when a skill is added to the actor
eventTips.skillremove: Event triggered when a skill is removed from the actor
eventTips.stateadd: Event triggered when a state is added to the actor
eventTips.stateremove: Event triggered when a state is removed from the actor
eventTips.equipmentadd: Event triggered when equipment is added to the actor
eventTips.equipmentremove: Event triggered when equipment is removed from the actor
eventTips.equipmentgain: Event triggered when the actor gains equipment
eventTips.itemuse: Event triggered by the 'Use Item' command
eventTips.itemgain: Event triggered when the actor gains an item
eventTips.moneygain: Event triggered when the actor gains money
eventTips.startup: Game startup event, triggered after preloading is complete
eventTips.createscene: The event automatically called when a scene is loaded for the first time, before 'Load Scene' events; cannot be triggered by loading a save
eventTips.loadscene: The event automatically called after a scene is loaded, before 'Autorun' events; can be triggered repeatedly when loading saves
eventTips.loadsave: The event automatically called after loading a save
eventTips.showtext: A synchronous event automatically called by the 'Show Text' command; waits for completion before continuing the main event, allowing custom dialogue boxes
eventTips.showchoices: A synchronous event automatically called by the 'Show Choices' command; waits for completion before continuing the main event, allowing custom choice interfaces
eventTips.keydown: Event triggered when a key is pressed on the keyboard, key code is obtained through the 'Set String' command
eventTips.keyup: Event triggered when a key is released on the keyboard, key code is obtained through the 'Set String' command
eventTips.mousedown: Event triggered when any mouse button is pressed, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.mousedownLB: Event triggered when the left mouse button is pressed, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.mousedownRB: Event triggered when the right mouse button is pressed, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.mouseup: Event triggered when any mouse button is released, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.mouseupLB: Event triggered when the left mouse button is released, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.mouseupRB: Event triggered when the right mouse button is released, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.mousemove: Event triggered when the mouse is moved
eventTips.mouseenter: Event triggered when the mouse enters the object
eventTips.mouseleave: Event triggered when the mouse leaves the object
eventTips.click: Event triggered when the mouse button is pressed and released
eventTips.doubleclick: Event triggered when the mouse button is pressed twice consecutively, on the second press
eventTips.wheel: Event triggered when the mouse wheel is scrolled, direction of scrolling obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.touchstart:
Event triggered when a finger touches the touchscreen
All simultaneous touch points trigger the event once
Touch point ID is obtained through the 'Traverse' command
Touch point position is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.touchmove:
Event triggered when a finger moves on the touchscreen
All simultaneous touch points trigger the event once
Touch point ID is obtained through the 'Traverse' command
Touch point position is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.touchend:
Event triggered when a finger leaves the touchscreen
All simultaneous touch points trigger the event once
Touch point ID is obtained through the 'Traverse' command
Touch point position is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.select: Event triggered when a button element is selected
eventTips.deselect: Event triggered when a button element is deselected
eventTips.input: Triggered when content is entered in a text box
eventTips.focus:
Event triggered when the text box enters input state
Focus added using the 'Set Focus' command triggers the event
eventTips.blur:
Event triggered when the text box exits input state
Focus removed using the 'Set Focus' command triggers the event
eventTips.ended: Event triggered when the animation or video element finishes playing
eventTips.gamepadbuttonpress: Event triggered when a gamepad button is pressed, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.gamepadbuttonrelease: Event triggered when a gamepad button is released, button code is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.gamepadleftstickchange: Event triggered when the left gamepad stick changes, stick angle is obtained through the 'Set Number' command
eventTips.gamepadrightstickchange: Event triggered when the right gamepad stick changes, stick angle is obtained through the 'Set Number' command

showText.name: Show Text
showText.desc:
Call the preset event to obtain the parameters and content of this command
You can create a dialog box and load the content through that event

showChoices.name: Show Choices
showChoices.desc:
Call the preset event to obtain the parameters and content of this command
You can create a choice window and load the content through that event

comment.name: Comment
comment.desc: Some text used to explain and illustrate

setBoolean.name: Set Boolean
setBoolean.desc: Write a boolean to a boolean type or non-existent variable

setNumber.name: Set Number
setNumber.desc: Write a number to a numeric type or non-existent variable

setString.name: Set String
setString.desc: Write a string to a string type or non-existent variable

setObject.name: Set Object
setObject.desc: Write an object to an object type or non-existent variable

setList.name: Set List
setList.desc: Create a list and write to an object type or non-existent variable, or modify a list read from a variable

deleteVariable.name: Delete Variable
deleteVariable.desc: Delete a variable that is no longer needed

getObjectProperty.name: Get Object Property
getObjectProperty.desc: Get the property of an Object

setObjectProperty.name: Set Object Property
setObjectProperty.desc: Set the property of an Object

if.name: If
if.desc:
Control the flow by checking conditions.
Enter the first branch that meets the condition.
A branch can have multiple conditions.

switch.name: Switch
switch.desc:
Control the flow by checking conditions.
If the variable is one of the values listed in the branch, enter the branch.

loop.name: Loop
loop.desc:
A block of commands executed repeatedly while the condition holds.
If logic is flawed, it may enter an infinite loop and make the game unresponsive.

forEach.name: For Each
forEach.desc: Fetch data one by one and assign it to the variable, execute the commands in the block each time it is acquired.

break.name: Break
break.desc: Break out of the "Loop" or "For Each" command block

continue.name: Continue
continue.desc: Jump to the next round of "Loop" or "For Each"

independent.name: Independent
independent.desc:
Separate the commands within the block for asynchronous execution (shared event variables).
Even if the event's host object is destroyed, commands in the block continue executing.
Avoid relying on this; putting loops inside may cause continuous background computation.
Warning: 'Reset' does not stop commands inside an 'Independent' block.

callEvent.name: Call Event
callEvent.desc: Trigger a global event or a specified object event.

return.name: Return To
return.tip: Accept a return value from the called event and write it to this variable.

return.name: Return
return.desc: Ends the current event. If it's a global event and a return type is specified, the return value can be passed to other events that called it.

stopEvent.name: Stop Event
stopEvent.desc: End the events currently being executed by various objects.

registerEvent.name: Register Event
registerEvent.desc:
Register or unregister a temporary event
The registered event shares local variables with the current event
The same event won't be registered more than once

setEvent.name: Set Event
setEvent.desc: Set the event currently being executed or a global event.

transition.name: Transition
transition.desc: Calculate interpolation each frame during the transition period and execute the commands within the block.

block.name: Block
block.desc: Stores commands in a block for easier folding and management, with the option to start a new execution branch.

label.name: Label
label.desc: Set a label at the current position for jumping, without executing any actual content.

jumpTo.name: Jump to
jumpTo.desc: Jump to the specified location and continue execution.

wait.name: Wait
wait.desc: Wait for a period of time before continuing to execute the subsequent commands.

setImage.name: Set Image
setImage.desc: Set the built-in properties of the image element.

loadImage.name: Load Image
loadImage.desc: Load a specific image into the element.

tintImage.name: Tint Image
tintImage.desc: Set the tint of the image element.

setText.name: Set Text
setText.desc: Set the built-in properties of the text element.

setTextBox.name: Set Text Box
setTextBox.desc: Set the built-in properties of the text box element.

setDialogBox.name: Set Dialog Box
setDialogBox.desc: Set the built-in properties of the dialog box element.

controlDialog.name: Control Dialog
controlDialog.desc: Call the built-in methods of the dialog element.

setProgressBar.name: Set Progress Bar
setProgressBar.desc: Set the built-in properties of the progress bar element.

setButton.name: Set Button
setButton.desc: Set the built-in properties of the button element.

controlButton.name: Control Button
controlButton.desc: Call the built-in methods of the button element.

setAnimation.name: Set Animation
setAnimation.desc: Set the built-in properties of the animation element.

setVideo.name: Set Video
setVideo.desc: Set the built-in properties of the video element.

setWindow.name: Set Window
setWindow.desc: Set the built-in properties of the window element.

waitForVideo.name: Wait For Video
waitForVideo.desc: Wait for the video element to finish playing before continuing to execute the subsequent commands.

setElement.name: Set Element
setElement.desc: Call the built-in methods of any element.

nestElement.name: Nest Element
nestElement.desc: Make the element a child of another element.

moveElement.name: Move Element
moveElement.desc: Set the transform properties of any element.

deleteElement.name: Delete Element
deleteElement.desc: Destroy the specified element. The element will no longer run its events.

setPointerEventRoot.name: Set Pointer Event Root
setPointerEventRoot.desc: Set the root element so only pointer events for it and its descendants fire, blocking others.

setFocus.name: Set Focus
setFocus.desc: After setting the focus element, you can control its descendant buttons with shortcuts and trigger the 'focus' event.

createObject.name: Create Object
createObject.desc: Create a preset object in the scene at a specified position.

moveLight.name: Move Light
moveLight.desc: Move the light source object to a specified position and set its built-in properties.

deleteObject.name: Delete Object
deleteObject.desc: Destroy the specified scene object. The object will no longer run events.

setState.name: Set State
setState.desc: Set the state's duration. The state is removed when the countdown reaches 0.

playAnimation.name: Play Animation
playAnimation.desc: Create an animation object that is destroyed automatically after it finishes.

setObjectAnimation.name: Set Object Animation
setObjectAnimation.desc: Temporarily change the visual properties of an object's animation

playAudio.name: Play Audio
playAudio.desc: Play background music, ambient sounds, sound effects, etc.

stopAudio.name: Stop Audio
stopAudio.desc: Immediately stop playing the specified type of sound.

setVolume.name: Set Volume
setVolume.desc: Adjust the volume of the sound.

setPan.name: Set Pan
setPan.desc: Adjust the left-right channel volume of the sound.

setReverb.name: Set Reverb
setReverb.desc: Simulate the echo in enclosed spaces (such as sewers, caves, halls) to enhance the environmental atmosphere.

setLoop.name: Set Loop
setLoop.desc: Toggle the looping mode of the sound.

saveAudio.name: Save Audio
saveAudio.desc: Save the current playback time of the audio.

restoreAudio.name: Restore Audio
restoreAudio.desc: Restore the last saved playback time and continue playing.

createActor.name: Create Actor
createActor.desc: Create a new actor at a specified position in the scene.

moveActor.name: Move Actor
moveActor.desc: Control the movement behavior of an actor.

followActor.name: Follow Actor
followActor.desc: Make an actor automatically follow another actor.

translateActor.name: Translate Actor
translateActor.desc: Move the actor a certain distance in a specified direction. This can be used for displacement skills, knockback effects, attraction effects, etc.

changeThreat.name: Change Threat
changeThreat.desc: Change the actor's threat level towards a target (a built-in property used to filter target actors).

setWeight.name: Set Weight
setWeight.desc: A built-in property of the actor that affects collision behavior.

setMovementSpeed.name: Set Movement Speed
setMovementSpeed.desc: A built-in property of the actor that affects movement speed.

setAngle.name: Set Angle
setAngle.desc: A built-in property of the actor that affects the direction of animation motions.

fixAngle.name: Fix Angle
fixAngle.desc: Toggle the lock status of the actor's angle.

setActive.name: Set Active
setActive.desc: Toggle the activation status of the actor. When deactivated, all the actor's events are paused.

getActor.name: Get Actor
getActor.desc: Get an actor near a specified position in the scene.

getMultipleActors.name: Get Multiple Actors
getMultipleActors.desc: Get multiple actors near a specified position in the scene.

deleteActor.name: Delete Actor
deleteActor.desc: Remove an actor from the scene. Global actors are moved to the background.

setPlayerActor.name: Set Player Actor
setPlayerActor.desc: After being set as the player actor, it can be accessed via the actor accessor (player actor).

setPartyMember.name: Set Party Member
setPartyMember.desc: Add or remove a party member. Must be a global actor.

changePassableTerrain.name: Change Passable Terrain
changePassableTerrain.desc: Change the passable terrain for a specified actor.

changeActorTeam.name: Change Actor Team
changeActorTeam.desc: Simultaneously change the relationships between the actor and other actors.

changeActorState.name: Change Actor State
changeActorState.desc: Call the built-in methods of the actor's state manager.

changeActorEquipment.name: Change Actor Equipment
changeActorEquipment.desc: Call the built-in methods of the actor's equipment manager.

changeActorSkill.name: Change Actor Skill
changeActorSkill.desc: Call the built-in methods of the actor's skill manager.

changeActorPortrait.name: Change Actor Portrait
changeActorPortrait.desc: Change the actor's appearance or expression.

changeActorAnimation.name: Change Actor Animation
changeActorAnimation.desc: Replace the actor's animation with a new one.

changeActorSprite.name: Change Actor Sprite
changeActorSprite.desc: Replace a sprite texture in the actor's animation.

changeActorMotion.name: Change Actor Motion
changeActorMotion.desc: Set the animation motion corresponding to the actor's special behavior.

playActorAnimation.name: Play Actor Animation
playActorAnimation.desc: Play an animation motion from the actor's animation, and return to the default motion after it finishes.

stopActorAnimation.name: Stop Actor Animation
stopActorAnimation.desc: Immediately stop the current animation motion, and return to the default motion.

addAnimationComponent.name: Add Animation Component
addAnimationComponent.desc: Add an extra animation component to the actor.

setAnimationComponent.name: Set Animation Component
setAnimationComponent.desc: Set the built-in properties of the animation component bound to the actor.

removeAnimationComponent.name: Remove Animation Component
removeAnimationComponent.desc: Remove the component specified animation and motion from the actor's animation component list.

createGlobalActor.name: Create Global Actor
createGlobalActor.desc: Global actor data is saved in the game save file.

transferGlobalActor.name: Transfer Global Actor
transferGlobalActor.desc: Transfer the global actor to a specified position in the current scene. If the actor already exists, the command has no effect.

deleteGlobalActor.name: Delete Global Actor
deleteGlobalActor.desc: Completely delete the global actor when it is no longer needed.

setTarget.name: Set Target
setTarget.desc: Set the specified actor as the 'Target Actor' in the actor accessor

getTarget.name: Get Target
getTarget.desc: Select a valid actor from the target pool of a specified actor, and assign it to the actor accessor's 'target actor'.

appendTarget.name: Append Target
appendTarget.desc: Add an actor to the actor's target pool.

removeTarget.name: Remove Target
removeTarget.desc: Remove an actor from the actor's target pool.

detectTargets.name: Detect Targets
detectTargets.desc: Search for nearby target actors that meet the conditions and add them to the target actor pool.

discardTargets.name: Discard Targets
discardTargets.desc: Discard some actors from the actor's target pool.

resetTargets.name: Reset Targets
resetTargets.desc: Remove all actors from the actor's target pool.

renderOutline.name: Render Outline
renderOutline.desc: Render the outline of the actor animation sprite.

castSkill.name: Cast Skill
castSkill.desc:
Triggers the 'Cast Skill' event.
If the skill doesn't exist or is on cooldown, the command is skipped.
The 'Cast Skill' event inherits the 'Target Actor' from the current event actor accessor.

setSkill.name: Set Skill
setSkill.desc: Increase or decrease the skill's cooldown time.

createTrigger.name: Create Trigger
createTrigger.desc:
Create a trigger (often used in skills) to capture actors and trigger the 'Hit Event'.
All trigger events inherit the 'Target Actor' from the current event actor accessor.

setTriggerSpeed.name: Set Trigger Speed
setTriggerSpeed.desc: Trigger's built-in property that affects the speed of movement.

setTriggerAngle.name: Set Trigger Angle
setTriggerAngle.desc: Trigger's built-in property that affects the movement angle and animation motion direction.

setTriggerDuration.name: Set Trigger Duration
setTriggerDuration.desc: Trigger's built-in property that automatically destroys the trigger after the timeout.

setTriggerMotion.name: Set Trigger Motion
setTriggerMotion.desc: Change the animation motion of the trigger.

setInventory.name: Set Inventory
setInventory.desc: Invoke the built-in methods of the actor's inventory.

setItem.name: Set Item
setItem.desc: Increase or decrease the quantity of an item. The item is removed from inventory when its quantity reaches 0.

setCooldown.name: Set Cooldown
setCooldown.desc: Set the cooldown time for the corresponding cooldown key, which counts down automatically in the background.

setShortcut.name: Set Shortcut
setShortcut.desc: Add an item or skill to the shortcut bar, or remove a specific shortcut slot.

activateScene.name: Activate Scene
activateScene.desc: Switch between the main scene and the background scene.

loadScene.name: Load Scene
loadScene.desc: Destroy the current scene and load a new one.

loadSubscene.name: Load Subscene
loadSubscene.desc: Load all objects from the specified subscene into the current scene.

unloadSubscene.name: Unload Subscene
unloadSubscene.desc: Unload all objects related to the subscene.

clampCamera.name: Clamp Camera
clampCamera.desc: Forces the camera to view only within a rectangular area, preventing the display of scenes outside the rectangle.

unclampCamera.name: Unclamp Camera
unclampCamera.desc: Removes the restriction on the camera's visible area.

moveCamera.name: Move Camera
moveCamera.desc: The camera position affects the visible area of the scene.

setZoomFactor.name: Set Zoom Factor
setZoomFactor.desc: The zoom factor for scene objects.

setAmbientLight.name: Set Ambient Light
setAmbientLight.desc: Change the ambient light of the current scene.

tintScreen.name: Tint Screen
tintScreen.desc: Change the tone of the scene's visuals.

shakeScreen.name: Shake Screen
shakeScreen.desc: Temporarily shake the camera to create a vibration visual effect.

setTile.name: Set Tile
setTile.desc: Replace a tile at a specific location in a tilemap.

deleteTile.name: Delete Tile
deleteTile.desc: Remove a tile at a specific location in a tilemap.

setTerrain.name: Set Terrain
setTerrain.desc: Change the terrain at a specified location.

setGameSpeed.name: Set Game Speed
setGameSpeed.desc: Affect the game speed by scaling the 'Delta Time', allowing for time to be paused.

setTeamRelation.name: Set Team Relation
setTeamRelation.desc: Change the relationship between two teams, either as enemies or allies.

switchCollisionSystem.name: Switch Collision System
switchCollisionSystem.desc: Toggle the built-in actor or scene collision system.

gameData.name: Game Data
gameData.desc: Save, load, or delete game data.

reset.name: Reset
reset.desc: Reset all game data to its initial state.

pauseGame.name: Pause Game
pauseGame.desc: Prevent scene pointer events from being triggered.

preventSceneInput.name: Prevent Scene Input
preventSceneInput.desc: Block scene pointer events from being triggered.

restoreSceneInput.name: Restore Scene Input
restoreSceneInput.desc: Allow scene pointer events to be triggered.

simulateKey.name: Simulate Key
simulateKey.desc: Force the triggering of keyboard events.

setLanguage.name: Set Language
setLanguage.desc: Switch the localization language and refresh the text content.

setResolution.name: Set Resolution
setResolution.desc: Change the canvas size, scene scaling factor, and UI scaling factor.

commandLine.name: Startup parameters
commandLine.desc: Operate on the startup parameters of the application

relaunchApp.name: Restart application
relaunchApp.desc: Restart the application. It will inherit the current process's startup parameters and restart.

confirmation.compileError: An error occurred while compiling, Continue?
confirmation.guidConflict:
The following files have duplicate GUIDs (16-character identifiers) and cannot be referenced correctly.

Import the contents of the "{filename}" file to the "{langname}" language pack.

confirmation.versionIsTooHigh: The project version is higher than the editor version and cannot be opened.

[duration].label: Duration
[duration].tip: Interpolation is calculated once per frame during the transition.

[wait].label: Wait
[wait].tip: Whether to wait for the command to complete execution.

true.name: Yes
true.tip: Wait for the related content to finish before executing the next event commands.

false.name: No
false.tip: Immediately execute the next event commands.
